entries.08c28b32fcc99542: A manufacturer-trading company serving manufacturing industries such as steel, automobiles and semiconductors, selling high-pressure hydraulic equipment and manufacturing and selling its own products such as rotary joints and high-pressure and precision cleaning equipment.
entries.0df2efcf6eb6e87d: Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was largest for steel at ¥15,822 million, followed by automotive at ¥12,179 million and electronics and semiconductors at ¥7,858 million. entries.0f085662b656f889: Headquartered in Hakata Ward, Fukuoka City, the company and 19 subsidiaries and two affiliates form the group. Its main businesses are purchase and sale and manufacturing and sale of industrial equipment, centered on high-pressure hydraulic applied equipment, and purchase and sale of precision measuring and inspection equipment. The reportable segments are eight industry-based segments, based on sales structures organized by customer industry. The number of consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 805.
